scientific_limitations: Only finite Cartesian products of \(K_{1,r_j}\) for integers \(r_j\ge2\), at least two factors, and strictly positive real adjacency weights.
No zero couplings, magnetic phases, on-site potentials, independently sampled clocks, or finite-time claims.
General theorem is analytical; exact rational replay covers 17 finite commensurate effective-frequency profiles.
An unlocated general result may imply part of the theorem; a related 2023 dissertation was only partially accessible.
title: Exact spectral-rank and positivity criterion for weighted Cartesian star boxes
